title: Quantifier list by level
statement: For each width $w\in\mathbb{N}$, define a sequence $Q_w$ of lists of quantifiers by $Q_w(0)=[]$ and, for every $r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $Q_w(r+1)$ be the concatenation of $w$ existential quantifiers, $2w$ universal quantifiers, and $Q_w(r)$, in that order.
